# pbs_datastores (Data Source)

Lists all Proxmox Backup Server datastore configurations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `stores` (Attributes List) List of all datastores. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stores))

<a id="nestedatt--stores"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stores`

Read-Only:

- `backing_device` (String) UUID of the filesystem partition for a removable datastore.
- `comment` (String) Description for the datastore.
- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the PBS configuration file the object is stored in (shared by all objects in that file; informational only).
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the datastore is disabled.
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate fingerprint for secure connections.
- `gc_schedule` (String) Garbage collection schedule in cron format.
- `keep_daily` (Number) Number of daily backups to keep.
- `keep_hourly` (Number) Number of hourly backups to keep.
- `keep_last` (Number) Number of latest backups to keep.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) Number of monthly backups to keep.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Number of weekly backups to keep.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) Number of yearly backups to keep.
- `maintenance_mode` (Attributes) Maintenance mode configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stores--maintenance_mode))
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the datastore.
- `notification_mode` (String) Notification delivery mode.
- `notify` (Attributes) Per-job notification settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stores--notify))
- `notify_level` (String) Notification level.
- `notify_user` (String) User to send notifications to.
- `path` (String) Filesystem path to the datastore data.
- `prune_schedule` (String) Prune schedule in cron format (deprecated in PBS 4.0+).
- `removable` (Boolean) Whether the datastore is backed by a removable device.
- `s3_bucket` (String) S3 bucket name for S3 datastores.
- `s3_client` (String) S3 endpoint ID for S3 datastores.
- `tuning` (Attributes) Advanced tuning options for datastore behaviour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stores--tuning))
- `verify_new` (Boolean) Verify newly created snapshots immediately after backup.

<a id="nestedatt--stores--maintenance_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stores.maintenance_mode`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Message shown in maintenance mode.
- `type` (String) Maintenance mode type.


<a id="nestedatt--stores--notify"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stores.notify`

Read-Only:

- `gc` (String) Garbage collection notification level.
- `prune` (String) Prune job notification level.
- `sync` (String) Sync job notification level.
- `verify` (String) Verification job notification level.


<a id="nestedatt--stores--tuning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stores.tuning`

Read-Only:

- `chunk_order` (String) Chunk iteration order.
- `gc_atime_cutoff` (Number) Garbage collection access time cutoff (seconds).
- `gc_atime_safety_check` (Boolean) Enable garbage collection access time safety check.
- `gc_cache_capacity` (Number) Garbage collection cache capacity.
- `sync_level` (String) Datastore fsync level.
